rspf.how: Shared constant. 94.9% of readings sit in segments of >= 10.

rspf.meaning: Number of HRV regimes.
rspf.effect: More: more baseline levels to switch between.
rspf.how: Activity states (sleep / rest / active, from the watch) whose HRV differs across patients (paired Wilcoxon, Bonferroni): sleep_vs_rest p=1.8e-07, rest_vs_active p=6.3e-06, sleep_vs_active p=7e-06

rspf.meaning: Probability of staying in the same regime at the next reading.
rspf.how: exp(-dt / tau), logit tau = 100 min.

rspf.meaning: Minutes for the level to revert to its regime mean.
rspf.how: Variogram correlation time in logit space.

rspf.meaning: Level shock per 10 min, as a fraction of the patient's spread.
rspf.how: Median per patient of sqrt(S(1-phi^2)) / spread (logit units).

rspf.meaning: Per-step drift of the circadian coefficients.
rspf.how: sqrt(day-to-day change of the harmonic coefficients / readings per day).

rspf.meaning: Starting circadian amplitude relative to the spread.
rspf.how: Median per patient of first-harmonic amplitude / spread.

rspf.meaning: Monte Carlo particles, RNG seed.
rspf.effect: More: less Monte Carlo noise, slower.
rspf.how: Kept.
